sections.title: Topics in Asian American Literature and Culture: Politics of Solidarity: South Asians in America
sections.description: This seminar explores Asian American literature and culture intensively; specific course topics will vary from year to year. See the English Department's website at www.english.upenn.edu for a description of the current offerings.
